name: @nubiia/mcp-borme

tools.name: borme_search_companies
tools.description: Search Spanish companies (BORME / Registro Mercantil) by name, alias or exact CIF. ALWAYS the first step: it returns the `slug` that every other company tool needs, plus CIF, province, CNAE code, share capital (cents), first/last BORME appearance and number of registry acts. Name search is by name prefix, so start with the distinctive start of the legal name (e.g. "Telefónica de España"), not a descriptive phrase. Only legal entities are returned; DNI/NIE never match. Paginate with offset (max 1000).

q.description: Company name (or the start of it), alias or exact CIF, e.g. "Telefónica de España" or "A82018474". Natural-person identifiers (DNI/NIE) always return zero results.

tools.name: borme_get_company
tools.description: Get the BORME report of one company by slug: identity (name, CIF, legal form, status, aliases), KPIs (number of acts, first/last seen), activity timeline by period, top event types and provinces, the most recent registry events, and current and historical officers. Use it for "tell me about company X". `events_limit` (default 10) bounds the event list; page the full history with borme_get_company_events. The report is documentary: it reflects BORME publications, not a certified registry extract.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

events_limit.description: How many of the most recent BORME events to include, 0-200 (default 10; 0 = none). The full history is paginated by borme_get_company_events.

tools.name: borme_compare_companies
tools.description: Compare exactly two companies side by side using the stable comparison projection (identity, province, CNAE, registry activity). Cheaper than fetching two full reports when the question is "which of these two ...". Both slugs must come from borme_search_companies.

items.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

slugs.description: Exactly two distinct company slugs to compare, e.g. ["empresa-a-sl","empresa-b-sl"].

tools.name: borme_get_company_events
tools.description: List the BORME events (registry acts) of a company for one calendar year, paginated: date, section, province, act type (Nombramientos, Ceses, Ampliación de capital, Disolución...) and the act text. Defaults to the current year, 20 per page; check `total` and `pages` and use `year` to walk back through the history (data from 2009).

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

year.description: Calendar year to list (1900 up to the current year). Defaults to the current year.

tools.name: borme_get_company_facts
tools.description: Structured facts extracted from the BORME acts of a company, grouped by type (appointments, removals, capital changes, mergers, registered-office moves...) with person name and role when applicable, plus a `summary` with the count per type. Use it to answer "who was appointed / what changed" without reading raw act text.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

tools.name: borme_get_company_timeline
tools.description: Unified chronological timeline of a company combining BORME registry acts and public procurement awards (PLACSP), newest first, each entry with date, category, source, source URL and confidence. The `limit` (default 30) bounds the list; the response reports `events_total`. Amounts are source-reported awards, not proof of payment.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

limit.description: Most recent timeline entries to return, 1-200 (default 30). The API returns the whole timeline; this bounds it for context.

tools.name: borme_get_company_officers
tools.description: Current and historical officers of a company as published in the BORME: administrators, attorneys (apoderados), auditors and similar roles with the date each was first seen. Documentary mentions only: no DNI, no contact data, and a mention does not prove the person still holds the role today. At most 500 mentions.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

tools.name: borme_get_company_relationships
tools.description: Documented relationships between a company and other entities (officers, domicile, contracts, grants, IP assets, corporate links, mentions), each with source, date, confidence and evidence URL. Filter with `type` and `confidence`. Documentary only: a relationship does not imply control, responsibility or current validity.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

confidence.description: Only relationships with this confidence level.

tools.name: borme_get_company_graph
tools.description: Corporate graph centred on a company: parents and children (group structure from GLEIF) with counts and coverage notes. Only entities that pass the OpenMercantil identity policy appear, so an empty graph does not mean the company has no group.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

tools.name: borme_get_company_activity
tools.description: Monthly time series of BORME activity for a company (number of registry acts per month, `series: [{period: "2024-05", count: 2}]`). Useful to spot dormant companies or bursts of corporate activity.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

tools.name: borme_get_similar_companies
tools.description: Companies in the same province and two-digit CNAE division, ranked by closeness of BORME act count. A documentary heuristic for finding peers or competitors, not a recommendation or a statement of any relationship.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

tools.name: borme_get_company_contracts
tools.description: Public procurement notices (PLACSP, contrataciondelestado.es) linked to the company by CIF: object, buyer, supplier, CPV codes, procedure, typed amounts (budget, estimated, award) and phase. The link is documentary and does not prove payment or executed spend; amounts of different kinds are never summed. Default 10, max 100.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

tools.name: borme_get_company_grants
tools.description: Public grants and subsidies (BDNS) awarded to the company, in integer cents of the awarded amount (never payments). Up to 200 attested rows. May answer 503 `projection_unavailable` when the integrations projection is offline: that is not evidence of "no grants".

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

tools.name: borme_get_company_ted
tools.description: European public procurement notices (TED) linked to the company NIF: publication number and date, buyer and the official notice URL. Rows do not prove payment or current contractual status. May answer 503 when the integrations projection is offline.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

tools.name: borme_get_company_cnmv
tools.description: Stock-market (CNMV) listing tuple of the company and its most recent regulatory events. Use it to check whether a company is listed. Empty coverage is not proof of non-listing. May answer 503 when the integrations projection is offline.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

tools.name: borme_get_company_wikidata
tools.description: Wikidata identifiers of the company: Q-id, entity URL, ticker and inception date (CC0 subset only; no labels, logos or websites). Useful to link the company to other datasets. May answer 503 when the integrations projection is offline.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

tools.name: borme_get_company_bde
tools.description: Banco de España (Central de Balances) sector ratios for the company’s two-digit CNAE: sector benchmarking such as net margin, ROA and ROE. It is NOT the company’s own financial statements. `coverage_status` tells whether the sector is projected; when it is not, `metrics` is empty.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

tools.name: borme_get_company_sources
tools.description: Coverage of the four external integrations for a company (BDNS grants, CNMV, TED, Wikidata): which are available or empty, with licence metadata. Call it before the individual integration tools to know which ones have data. May answer 503 when the integrations projection is offline.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

tools.name: borme_get_daily_summary
tools.description: What the BORME published on one date: every registry act grouped by BORME section and province (company, act type, company slug). The raw day can hold thousands of acts, so the response gives exact counts per section and province plus the first `limit` acts per province (default 10). Narrow with `province` and/or `section` before raising the limit. `province` ignores case and accents and accepts part of a name of 3+ characters ("alava" finds "Araba/Álava"); if nothing matches, the response lists `available_provinces`. The BORME is not published on Sundays or national holidays (404), and this dataset may lag behind today: check borme_get_health (`latest_borme_processed`) if a recent date is missing.

date.description: Publication date, YYYY-MM-DD. BORME is not published on Sundays or national holidays (those dates return 404).

province.description: Only this province, e.g. "Madrid" or "Málaga". Case/accent-insensitive; a partial name of 3+ characters works ("alava" finds "Araba/Álava"). If nothing matches, the response lists available_provinces.

section.description: BORME section: "1" = Sección Primera (registered acts: constitutions, appointments, capital...), "2" = Sección Segunda (announcements and notices). Default: both.

limit.description: Maximum acts returned per province, 1-200 (default 10). Counts always cover everything.

tools.name: borme_search_persons
tools.description: Search people mentioned in the BORME by name (usually as officers: administrators, attorneys, auditors). Returns name mentions with `slug`, number of mentions and companies, and first/last seen. These are NOT identity profiles: two people with the same name share one slug. Use the slug with borme_get_person.

q.description: Person name as written in the BORME, e.g. "Garcia Lopez Eduardo". Results are unresolved name mentions (homonyms are possible), not identity profiles.

tools.name: borme_get_person
tools.description: Documentary report of the BORME mentions of a person slug: the companies and roles where the name appears, with dates. Does not infer identity or whether the person still holds a role. Withheld, ambiguous or absent identities answer 404.

slug.description: Person slug, e.g. "garcia-lopez-eduardo". Get it from borme_search_persons.

tools.name: borme_get_person_graph
tools.description: Person-to-company graph built only from BORME mentions of a person slug: the companies connected to that name. Does not infer control, identity or vigency.

slug.description: Person slug, e.g. "garcia-lopez-eduardo". Get it from borme_search_persons.

tools.name: borme_list_sector_companies
tools.description: List companies of a CNAE sector (1-4 characters: section letter, 2-digit division such as "62" for IT programming/consulting, or a longer code), optionally within one province. Sorted by BORME activity by default; with `province` use sort=recent (default) or oldest. Use for prospecting and market mapping; 20 per page, offset up to 1000. Find codes with borme_get_cnae_tree.

cnae.description: CNAE-2009 code: a section letter (e.g. "J"), a 2-digit division (e.g. "62") or a longer numeric code.

sort.description: Order: acts (most BORME activity, default without province), recent, oldest, name. With `province` only recent (default) and oldest are accepted.

tools.name: borme_get_sector_ratios
tools.description: Banco de España (Central de Balances) aggregate ratios for a two-digit CNAE division by year (net margin, ROA, ROE...). Sector benchmark only, never company-specific figures. `ratios` is empty when the sector is not in the reviewed aggregate.

cnae.description: Two-digit CNAE division, e.g. "62" (programming and IT consulting).

tools.name: borme_get_cnae
tools.description: Metadata of a CNAE-2009 code: description, level, parent and number of companies. Works for section letters and two-digit divisions; longer codes may answer 404. Use it to confirm what a `cnae_code` from a company search means.

code.description: CNAE-2009 code: a section letter (e.g. "J"), a 2-digit division (e.g. "62") or a longer numeric code.

tools.name: borme_get_cnae_tree
tools.description: The CNAE-2009 hierarchy (sections and divisions) with company counts, to look up the right sector code for borme_list_sector_companies or borme_get_sector_ratios. About 13 KB: call it once, not per question.

tools.name: borme_list_legal_norms
tools.description: Catalogue of the core Spanish mercantile-law norms (Código de Comercio, Ley de Sociedades de Capital, Reglamento del Registro Mercantil, concursal law...) with slug, short name, type and whether in force. Start here to find the `slug` used by borme_get_legal_norm and borme_get_legal_article. Informational, not legal advice.

tools.name: borme_get_legal_norm
tools.description: One norm: BOE/ELI identification, its key articles (with a flag for seeded consolidated text) and the BORME act types it governs. Informational, not legal advice; the official text is on boe.es.

slug.description: Norm slug, e.g. "codigo-de-comercio". Get it from borme_list_legal_norms.

tools.name: borme_get_legal_article
tools.description: Consolidated text (`body_html`) of one article of a norm, with its ELI anchor and version date. Article numbers join bis/ter with a hyphen ("160-bis"). Informational, not legal advice; the official text is on boe.es.

n.description: Article number; a bis/ter suffix is joined with a hyphen, e.g. "160-bis".

tools.name: borme_get_act_map
tools.description: Which law governs which BORME act type: maps registry act types (constitución, nombramiento, ampliación de capital, disolución, concurso...) to the norm and articles that regulate them. Without `acto` returns the full map (about 11 KB); with `acto` one mapping. Use it to answer "what law governs this registry act". Not legal advice.

acto.description: BORME act-type slug to look up one mapping. Omit to get the full act-type to norm map.

tools.name: borme_search_tenders
tools.description: Search Spanish public procurement notices (PLACSP) by object/buyer text, CPV prefix, phase, province, buyer NIF, supplier CIF, open status, amount range (requires amount_kind) and publication dates. Cursor-paginated: pass back `cursor` for the next page. Constraints: free text cannot be combined with structured filters, and `cpv` combines only with the date filters (otherwise the API answers 422). Supplier names are not searchable; use supplier_cif.

q.description: Terms in the notice object or buyer name (supplier names are NOT searched).

cpv.description: CPV code prefix, 2-8 digits (e.g. "72" for IT services). Combines only with the date filters.

phase.description: Notice phase: PUB published, PRE prior notice, EV evaluation, ADJ awarded, RES resolved, ANUL annulled.

province.description: Province slug, e.g. "madrid". Rows not yet geocoded are excluded.

buyer_nif.description: NIF of the contracting body (corporate identifiers only).

supplier_cif.description: CIF of the awarded supplier (corporate identifiers only).

open_only.description: Only notices still open for bids.

amount_kind.description: Which monetary concept min_amount_eur/max_amount_eur refer to. Required with either bound.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response to get the next page. Invalid if any filter changes.

tools.name: borme_get_tender
tools.description: One procurement notice by `key` (from borme_search_tenders): buyer, supplier, lots, CPV codes, procedure, typed amounts and results. Monetary concepts (budget, estimated, award) are never mixed. Uncertain supplier identities are withheld.

tools.name: borme_get_tender_stats
tools.description: Coverage and freshness metrics of the procurement dataset (record counts, geography, documents). No monetary rollups. Use it to judge how complete tender data is.

tools.name: borme_list_tender_suppliers
tools.description: Corporate suppliers ranked by number of public contract awards (only suppliers matched to a company by CIF; natural persons omitted; no monetary totals). Default 10, max 50.

tools.name: borme_get_health
tools.description: OpenMercantil service status and BORME freshness: `status` (ok/stale), `latest_borme_processed` (last bulletin date loaded), approximate company and event counts and degraded flags. Call it when a recent date or company seems missing, or before stating that something "has not been published yet".

tools.name: borme_get_stats
tools.description: Size of the public dataset: number of legal entities published and an approximate count of person mentions, with the build timestamp.

tools.name: borme_get_sources_freshness
tools.description: Per-source freshness map (BORME, PLACSP, BDNS, CNMV, annual accounts...): last update time and status of each public source behind the data, including a global label. Use it to qualify how current an answer is. About 12 KB.
